questions.question: What exactly did Lane C parity measure, and which retired modules would a restored path need?
questions.answer: Per-scenario compiled-vs-legacy-replay equivalence delegated to frozen evaluateRouteGold; statuses match/drift/vacuous/n-a/resolver-missing; only match passed. Restore needs the four named modules plus _args, advisor-probe, cutover-playbook-executor, vitest suite, loop-host registration, and run-skill-benchmark or a thin driver; full lane was 268 files in b45ea54cea3.

questions.question: Can compiledRoute(hubId, taskText) decisions be checked against each routing scenario's gold, and what is the scenario count?
questions.answer: Yes. compiledRoute returns action+selectionKind+qualified targets (verified live); qualifiedIdToLeaf bridges to leaf ids; leaf-manifest.json declares mode leaves for must-include granularity. Corpus: 262 gold-bearing playbook files across 44 dirs for the 5 hubs; plus 67 normalized canary-cases (50 route/7 defer/7 reject/3 clarify) as smoke-only. Semantic change vs parity is required and must be recorded.

questions.question: What else does admission need beyond the check (HUB_CHILD/DEFAULT_ON_HUBS freeze, manifest re-mint, guard freshness)?
questions.answer: Cohort hardcoded in six places test-enforced to move together: HUB_CHILD (engine), DEFAULT_ON_HUBS (resolver), guard HUBS, advisor COMPILED_ROUTING_HUBS+DEFAULT_ON_HUBS, serving-closure.manifest.json, authored spec-tree twins. mint produces inert legacy/shadowOnly manifest; refresh recompiles gen+1 preserving serving; flip is authored-only flip-serving.cjs whose scorer gate is now stale (dead SCORER_DIR). Guard enforces freshness+authored-drift; pre-commit auto-remint hook reads hub list from guard HUBS; resolver binds route identity to manifest at serve time.

questions.question: What does each candidate path cost and risk, including keeping admission closed?
questions.answer: Restore: ~3700-line surgical landing (or 268-file lane), freeze re-owning, path-churn verification; highest bar fidelity but to a replay proxy. New checker: ~500-800 lines on live deps; semantic-bar change + self-grading + coverage-blindness risks, each mitigable. Keep closed: ~0 cost but permanent admission block, unmeasured admitted-hub drift, stranded ready-mints, compounding doc debt. Archived measured verdicts: all-7 parity, 0 drift, 258/258, 47/47.

questions.question: Which path is recommended, and what would a later phase build and test?
questions.answer: Path B — new gold checker (check-compiled-routing.cjs: two-shape gold loader + comparator port + rollup + corpus-completeness gate + report), vitest suite, admission runbook (HUB_CHILD -> checker -> mint/refresh -> flip -> cohort tables -> sync promote -> guard green), doc fixes (seven->five, bar redefinition, flip scorer-gate repair). Restore only if bar must stay '== legacy replay'; closed only with explicit cohort-frozen decision.
